personal.bio: 3+ years of internet commercialization product experience at Alibaba International (Lazada) and Tencent (WeChat Ads). Deep expertise in display advertising, feed ads, and social advertising. Led multiple 0-to-1 product initiatives. Master's in Business Analytics with strong data-to-strategy translation skills.

highlights: Led WeCom (Enterprise WeChat) integration for ad conversion workflows, driving iterative improvements on the full-link capability
Owned Moments ad inventory monetization strategy, driving revenue uplift for the core placement
Drove display advertising product upgrades — redesigned ad formats, targeting, and bidding to improve advertiser ROI
Built AIGC-powered Q&A chatbot for the advertiser platform, reducing support tickets and improving self-serve onboarding
